title: Alembic and Balance Workcorner
description: One static fantasy alchemy workcorner scene, four complete qualified existing models and zero new reusable models. The whole swan-neck retort and receiver stand on their original grounded plinth at rear-left. A complete open worktable at front-right supports the entire fixed two-pan apothecary balance on its actual full base footprint; suspended pans overhang the tabletop sides while remaining above it. One unchanged empty wide bookcase stands separately behind the table. A single scene-only low stone floor gives a common placement datum and clear front access space. No book set is split or resized to fit a shelf, no extra bottles are piled in and no old component is removed or recoloured. Every original active mesh, evaluated world-space oriented triangle and constant opaque PBR is retained under unit translation. Original GLB node transforms are fully evaluated by the embedded byte-pinned established reader, then baked into editable mesh positions; original node hierarchy and custom NORMAL bytes are not claimed unchanged. Normals are recomputed flat. This is one scene and no new prop, not a room shell, working laboratory, simulated distillation/weighing/magic, navigable safety certification or load guarantee.
